skills.name: ord-portal
skills.description: Look up and prove Bitcoin facts with bitmap22's free Ord Portal and Agent Blockhall tools, each answer read from the chain and checked against a second source. Covers blocks and every transaction in them, ordinal inscriptions (where they came from, who holds them, what their code asks for), collections (which pieces are a parent's real children), bitmaps and their Earned Traits, runes, fees, stuck transactions, alerts when something happens, and a safety scan of new inscriptions. Use when someone asks whether an inscription, collection piece, bitmap or rune is real or what it is, what is in a block, what fee to pay, why a transaction is stuck, or wants to track the chain, or mentions ordportal.com, Agent Blockhall or a bitmap.
